Intel: Python code with syntax errors should report diagnostics

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Tree\Sitter\Language\Pack\TreeSitterLanguagePack;
use Tree\Sitter\Language\Pack\Language;
use Tree\Sitter\Language\Pack\ProcessConfig;
use Tree\Sitter\Language\Pack\Tree;
$config = \Tree\Sitter\Language\Pack\ProcessConfig::from_json(json_encode(["diagnostics" => true, "language" => "python"]));
$result = TreeSitterLanguagePack::process("def broken(\n    pass\n", $config);
var_dump($result->language);
var_dump($result->getMetrics()->errorCount);
var_dump($result->getDiagnostics());
```
